title: Reborn in Astralis
description: You were just a regular high school student in Tokyo — until a blinding light swallowed you whole. Now you stand in a marble throne room, surrounded by robed priests and a desperate king, declared the Hero prophesied to slay the Demon Lord. Classic isekai adventure awaits.

npcs.name: Seraphina
npcs.note: Princess, third daughter of King Aldric. She performed the Hero Summoning ritual and feels personally responsible for Kenji's fate. Knowledgeable about magic and this world's lore.

npcs.name: Aldric
npcs.note: King of Astralis. A weary ruler whose kingdom has been shrinking for a decade under the Demon Lord's advance. Pragmatic — he needs a Hero, not a friend.

npcs.name: Davan
npcs.note: Sir Davan, appointed as Kenji's escort and combat instructor. Gruff and skeptical that a scrawny otherworlder can be the prophesied Hero, but duty-bound to protect him.

scenarios.label: Echo Mastery Triggers
scenarios.prompt: Kenji's unique skill Echo Mastery suddenly activates. He witnesses someone nearby use a remarkable ability — a spell, a combat technique, or something stranger — and the skill copies it. Describe the moment of activation, what he copied, and the surprise or alarm of anyone watching.

scenarios.label: Guild Registration
scenarios.prompt: Kenji is brought to the Adventurers' Guild to officially register as a Hero. The guild master and other adventurers react to seeing the prophesied Hero — some with awe, others with open skepticism. Include the registration process, a stats evaluation, and a memorable encounter with another adventurer.

scenarios.label: Demon Lord's Herald Arrives
scenarios.prompt: A dark envoy from the Demon Lord arrives at the palace gates under a black flag of parley. The herald delivers an ultimatum or a taunting message directly addressed to the Hero by name, implying the Demon Lord already knows about Kenji's summoning. Describe the confrontation and King Aldric's strained response.

scenarios.label: Night Ambush
scenarios.prompt: In the dead of night, assassins slip into the palace and strike at Kenji's chambers. They are professionals — quiet, coordinated, and well-informed about his routine. Describe the attack, how Kenji (and anyone nearby) responds, and who might be behind it.

scenarios.label: First Dungeon
scenarios.prompt: Sir Davan leads Kenji into a nearby dungeon as a real combat trial. The dungeon has its own atmosphere and a threat Kenji isn't ready for. Describe the descent, the first genuine monster encounter, and a moment where Kenji's otherworld instincts either help or get him into trouble.

scenarios.label: Brutal Training Session
scenarios.prompt: Sir Davan puts Kenji through a gruelling training session in the palace yard — footwork, weapon forms, endurance drills. Kenji struggles badly, earning the silent judgment of watching knights. Then something unexpected happens that shifts Davan's opinion, even slightly.

scenarios.label: A Second Hero?
scenarios.prompt: Rumour reaches the palace that the summoning ritual may have pulled in more than one soul from the other world. Another person, disoriented and very different from Kenji, is reportedly found somewhere in the kingdom. Describe how word reaches Kenji, what little is known, and the political tension it creates at court.

scenarios.label: Seraphina's Confession
scenarios.prompt: Seraphina pulls Kenji aside in private and tells him something about the Hero Summoning ritual that she deliberately withheld — something that would have changed his reaction on the first day. It is not a betrayal, but it is a burden she has been carrying. Describe the confession and Kenji's response.

scenarios.label: Hero's Welcome Feast
scenarios.prompt: The king holds a formal banquet in Kenji's honour. The hall is full of nobles, knights, and dignitaries — some genuinely celebratory, others watching him like an investment. Kenji must navigate unfamiliar customs, food, and politics. Include at least one awkward moment and one genuine human connection.

entries.text:
White light. Then cold marble under your knees.

Your school bag is still on your shoulder. Your half-eaten convenience-store onigiri is still in your hand. One moment you were crossing the crosswalk near Shibuya Station, and now — this.

You're kneeling at the centre of a vast summoning circle etched in silver on a throne room floor. Dozens of candles gutter in the sudden draft. Robed priests stagger back in exhaustion. And before you, on a stepped dais, sits an old man in heavy ceremonial armour with a crown of hammered gold.
It worked. The Hero has come.
A young woman in silver robes steps out from behind the circle's edge. She has the same sharp eyes as the king and ink-stained fingers that suggest long nights of study. She bows — to you.

Forgive the abrupt summons. I am Seraphina, third princess of Astralis. You have been called from your world by the Rite of the Undying Hero. You are... in another world entirely. I know this must be overwhelming.

Something clicks into place behind your eyes — a new instinct, sharp and patient. You don't have words for it yet, but the sense is clear: if you watch someone do something, some part of you will know how to do it too.

A heavy boot scrapes the floor. A knight with a trimmed beard and a scar across his chin crosses his arms and looks you over like livestock at market.
This is the Hero? He's holding... a rice ball.
